day_shape: 82 items: US-Iran technical talks open in Switzerland under Islamabad MoU with reported 60-day roadmap, IDF reveals Iranian-built Hezbollah drone tunnel at Majdal Zoun, Iran exports 36m barrels since 15 June per Tanker Trackers, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: US-Iran Switzerland technical talks
threads.summary: Technical negotiations under the Islamabad memorandum opened in Burgenstock with Qatari and Pakistani mediation, led on Iran's side by Deputy FM Kazem Gharibabadi. Pakistan's PM and IRIB said the first high-level committee meeting produced a roadmap toward a final agreement within 60 days, with Lebanon enforcement a central issue.

threads.label: Iranian domestic backlash to MoU
threads.summary: Hardline outlets accused Iran's negotiating team of disregarding Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei's objections, and a lawmaker disclosed alleged Khamenei correspondence opposing US deal terms. Iran International also reported disputes over postwar pro-state street rallies, while Khamenei's office warned of enemy 'media operations' targeting national unity.

threads.label: Iran oil flows and Hormuz
threads.summary: Tanker Trackers reported Iran exported 36 million barrels of crude since 15 June with roughly the same volume still afloat, and Bloomberg said sellers cut prices to Chinese buyers. IRIB claimed a second container ship berthed at Shahid Rajaee after the end of a US naval blockade; the Jerusalem Post reported Hormuz transits fell sharply Sunday after Iran announced a closure.

threads.label: Majdal Zoun Hezbollah tunnel exposed
threads.summary: The IDF's 91st Division revealed a 200m-long, 25m-deep Hezbollah tunnel under Majdal Zoun in southern Lebanon containing hundreds of weapons, four launch shafts and 12 rooms, describing it as an Iranian-financed underground drone 'airbase'. The military said over 20 Hezbollah operatives were killed in the operation.

threads.label: Lebanon ceasefire friction
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported four IDF soldiers killed in a Hezbollah attack, an Israeli official saying the IDF would not withdraw from Lebanon, and consideration of letting the Lebanese army take a Hezbollah tunnel compound in Tebnit. The IDF Home Front Command lifted gathering restrictions on northern border communities from 6am, and Chief of Staff Zamir visited Lt-Col Dor Ben Simhon's family.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and October 7 reckoning
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said an airstrike in southern Gaza killed Zaki Youssef Mahmoud Abu Mustafa, Islamic Jihad's Khan Younis Nukhba commander who took part in abducting Yagil Yaakov from Kibbutz Nir Oz on 7 October. A separate northern Gaza strike killed Hamas West Jabalia engineering chief Ahmad Munir Khalil Zaza, while the Norwegian Refugee Council reported nearly one million Gazans still in tents.

threads.summary: Pakistan's role mediating the Switzerland talks drew analysis from the Jerusalem Post citing JD Vance's praise for Islamabad. IRIB confirmed President Pezeshkian will travel to Pakistan tomorrow for a one-day visit to follow up on economic ties.
